# Celox AI

> Celox AI is fleet management software for businesses in Israel. It manages vehicles, drivers, costs and documents in one place, with alerts before inspections, insurance and licenses expire.

The product is a web application (Hebrew and English). The marketing site is available in Hebrew (Israel) and English (United States).

## Key pages

- [Celox AI — Hebrew (Israel)](https://celoxai.com/il): overview of the platform in Hebrew
- [Celox AI — English (United States)](https://celoxai.com/us): overview of the platform in English
- [Privacy policy](https://celoxai.com/privacy): what data is collected and how it is used

## What the platform includes

- Vehicle management with live status tracking
- Driver management and license tracking
- Cost management with categories and a monthly budget
- Cloud documents: insurance, licenses and files from any device
- Scheduled maintenance and alerts before expiry
- Reports and cost analysis per vehicle and per fleet

## Who it is for

Fleet managers and traffic-safety officers at companies that operate vehicle fleets.
